title: Execution of a straight code segment within a set
statement: Let $W$ be a word width, $P$ a program, $K$ a set of integer addresses, $l$ a list of instructions, $pc$ a program counter, and $m$ a memory. Suppose $l$ is a prefix of the program beginning at $pc$, every instruction in $l$ is straight, and for every instruction in $l$ and every memory, all addresses that instruction touches belong to $K$. Then executing $|l|$ steps from configuration $(pc,m)$ ends at program counter $pc+|l|$ with memory obtained by applying the effects of the instructions in $l$ successively to $m$, and every step's touched addresses lie in $K$.
hypotheses_covered: l is a prefix of P.drop pc
Every instruction in l is straight
For every instruction in l and every memory, its touched addresses are contained in K
